title: Extend Pro 4 to 5.x
summary: The L1 caution dialog behind the new-major notice's Extend Pro 4 to 5.x…: Pro 4's line widens from 4.x to 4.x and 5.x, so its 64 licenses get DJDL 5 at no charge, starting with 5.0.0-beta.1. It shows the change in one row, says what narrowing it later would do, and starts focus on Cancel.
compare: Opens over the Licenses page (entitlements.new-major) from the notice's Extend Pro 4 to 5.x… (and the same item in Pro 4's ⋯, and from widening Pro 4's major line). It is an L1 caution confirm (.dialog.caution, the warning glyph before the title); focus starts on Cancel, drawn with its 2px focus ring, because the change gives every holder a free major.
The first sentence names who gets what and when: Pro 4's 64 licenses, 5.0.0-beta.1 at the next update check (Pro 4 includes the beta track), 5.0.0 when it reaches stable, at no charge.

The summary is one row, the change as before → after: 'Versions 4.x → 4.x and 5.x' (the 64 is in the button). A note says narrowing it back later stops updates for devices already on 5.x. The stored range is not shown (it is mechanism).
A line points to Start a 5.x tier… for charging for DJDL 5 instead.

The primary says exactly what happens: 'Give 64 licenses 5.x'. After it, Pro 4's Versions read '4.x and 5.x · from Duration', a toast says 'Pro 4 now covers 5.x', and the notice is gone from Licenses and from Pro 4's record.
The page behind keeps New license as its one primary; the notice's actions are outline buttons and its × dismisses.
Phone: a bottom sheet; the summary keeps its row; Cancel and Give 64 licenses 5.x sit side by side in two equal columns, in tab order.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

designReview.reviewer: Three UX designers (layout and spacing; interaction and flow; accessibility and responsive), triaged by the lead designer
designReview.verdict: Applied every accepted change; declined items are recorded with the lead's reason.

findings.issue: The stored range was mechanism, the summary tile repeated the button's count, and the confirmation level and starting focus were stated in the compare but not drawn.
findings.resolution: Cut 'Saved as 4.0.0 to 5.999999.999999.'; the summary is one row, 'Versions 4.x → 4.x and 5.x', with the 64 only in the button; kept 'Narrowing it later stops updates for devices already on 5.x.'; marked L1 with .dialog.caution and its leading glyph; drew the 2px focus ring on Cancel. The page behind is the converged new-major. The screen opts into the lead's new kit defaults with .kit-next on its console root (in-sentence links underlined, the warm light warning tint, 44px phone targets, the one-row phone save bar, two-up sheet feet, the white light-theme switch knob, the segmented ring, aligned On/Off, status words at the cell size).

findings.issue: Builders would copy ARIA that axe flags: switches named 'On', presets and filters as role=tablist with no tabs, an unnamed breadcrumb nav, glyph-only kind icons.
findings.resolution: Switches are <button class="switch" role="switch" aria-checked aria-labelledby="<row title>">; presets, the Versions and When it ends groups, the kind and ledger filters and the holder control are role=radiogroup with role=radio items; crumbs are <nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">; a glyph that stands alone (a kind icon on phone, a feature glyph) is role=img with an aria-label, and decorative glyphs and avatar initials are aria-hidden. axe-core 4.13 reports 0 violations on all 12 screens, both themes, at 1440 and 390.

findings.issue: Update the compares to say the phone dialog feet and the add-on header actions stack full width.
findings.resolution: declined: The kit now puts two actions side by side (.kit-next sheet feet, .action-pair). That fixes the reversed visual vs tab order and matches the existing compares, so the render changes and the compares don't.

Body is two lines: 'Pro 4's 64 licenses get DJDL 5 from 5.0.0-beta.1, at no charge.' and the Versions row; 'Narrowing later stops updates for devices on 5.x.' is a caption inside the preview box; 'Charge for 5.x instead' is a tertiary link at the footer's left; initial focus stays on Cancel.

findings.issue: The dialog sat 110px from the top of a 1,500px blurred page and the label/value gap was about 160px.
findings.resolution: The screen is one viewport tall (.console.modal-host) so the backdrop covers the viewport; the dialog sits at 12vh, max-height 90vh with a scrolling body and pinned foot; the summary is the shared .sum-box/.sum-row (36px, 96px label column); phone stays a bottom-anchored sheet.
